bindings.command: uname -r; for p in /sys/bus/platform/devices/soc:fingerprint_fpc /sys/bus/platform/devices/soc:xiaomi_fingerprint /sys/bus/platform/devices/soc:xiaomi_hall; do ls -ld "$p/driver"; done

fingerprint.command: dumpsys fingerprint; ps -A | grep -i fingerprint; getprop | grep -i fpc

nfc.command: dumpsys nfc; pm list features | grep -i nfc; service list | grep -i nfc; ls -l /dev/pn* /dev/nq* /dev/st21*

acceptance: Binding and framework initialization only; real cover transitions and biometric enrollment/authentication require physical verification
